unresolved_objections: The close EIO is a controlled host injection, not a naturally observed POSIX close failure.
Because the failure shim returns before the real syscall, the observed live descriptor is a fixture assumption and not a general OS close-error rule.
The complete mGBA translation units, frontend caller dispatch, and unrelated subsystem cleanup are not executed.
The harness manually owns a VFile pointer after production teardown to safely close the test resource; production code does not retain or retry it.
Same-kernel page cache and mapping cleanup are not power-loss durability, .sav interoperability, stock gameplay, or physical Flash evidence.
All selected original records remain partial/non-approving; transitive distribution licensing and independent semantic review remain unresolved.
